_refresh_note: Verified current Standard rows on 2026-10-04 independently from provider credit/API pages. Existing historical rows retain their prior evidence dates. Gemini 3.8 Flash paid text doubles on 2027-01-01: dated scenarios encode both periods; the promotional flat reference becomes unavailable at that UTC boundary until reviewed/reset. Opaque codex-auto-review historical rates are retained but excluded from current estimates because the current model cannot be established from that identifier.
_note: Flat rows are current Standard paid-text reference estimates, not historical invoices. New October rows have independent credit/API provider evidence in rate_provenance; historical rows retain earlier dates and are not reverified. Claude cache reads and five-minute writes are disjoint input subsets; reasoning is included in output. Other service tiers, long context, modalities, cache storage and tools require separate evidence and remain estimated/unavailable (issue #248). Gemini 2.5 Pro and 3.1 Pro Preview are deliberately not given flat rows because prompt-size tiers cannot be represented here. Gemini 3.8 Flash doubles on January 1, 2027: the dated catalog encodes the change and the temporary flat reference expires. Daybreak mappings are bounded assumptions from the credit card; API aliases can depend on approved access and change, so they must be reviewed and expire. The opaque historical codex-auto-review id is excluded from current pricing rather than rewritten to the model currently used for auto review. Version-11 defaults are recognized only by equality with the archived bundle; indistinguishable identical user entries follow the default policy, differing values are preserved for review. Earlier unknown bundles retain existing values and dates. Reset replaces the full card after explicit confirmation. No provider fetch is performed.
